semanticNotesAsFaqOnly: Official FAQ hierarchy: this FAQ over older core when inconsistent, then any newly issued core over this FAQ when inconsistent.
Question about a paid Flow spell countered by Abandon starts here; answer continues page 2.
Continues Flow spell: leaving the stack for any cause other than its own instructed execution is replaced by banish, including counter then return-to-hand.
The two illustrated units distinguish battlefield identity captured from trigger conditions versus current battlefield checked when an attack ability resolves; exact printings remain unbound here.
Empowered Mel plus Moonfall: chosen enemy receives -3 Might; all other enemies at the chosen battlefield receive -2, because only the chosen unit is targeted.
Empowered Mel plus Knock: replacement gives -2 while inheriting minimum Might1; answer continues page4.
Continues minimum-Might restriction inherited through replacement.
Empowered Mel: opponent Abandon can target a protected spell and performs Insight, but cannot counter or return the protected spell.
Mind control/counter are separate instructions; protected spell control may change while countering remains prevented.
Soul Snare remaking choices may choose any number of targets or modes; choices not remade remain, with continuation on page5.
Remade-choice continuation: if remaking any choice, unremade choices must also remain legal; choosing to remake nothing preserves original choices even if illegal.
Face-down standby locality restriction remains after control change.
Copy goggles copy printed/copyable characteristics, not empowered state, boons or transient statuses.
Akshan stealing attached copy goggles: old host loses copy, new host attaches first then receives copy; copying Niewresk afterwards does not retroactively observe attachment.
Attachment replacement operation is sequential, not simultaneous.
This FAQ explicitly supersedes an older Forge FAQ answer for Spear Song copying attach-trigger text; current core and exact printing reconciliation remain open.
Copied Azir activated ability may be used again after removing and reattaching goggles to create a fresh copied ability instance; host identity and temporary modifiers remain.
Combat damage prevention replacements can be ordered by controller: shield first prevents all four damage and leaves three prevention, trap first lets one damage through with no prevention left.
Damage replacement applicability is described at combat damage assignment; current core clause numbering/semantics still need per-case reconciliation.
Continues page8 Sands counter: played/confirmed history remains even if the other confirmed spell is later countered; not restricted to the same opponent casting both.

Falling Feline battlefield name declaration: response is possible before the naming trigger resolves, but too late after the exact unique spell is named; preexisting same-name stack spells remain unaffected.
Card naming must identify an existing card uniquely, cannot name a characteristic tag or impossible object.
Kayle has up to three countable empowered states: disempower removes one; her empower ability can still activate at the cap but produces no new state.
Fateweaver targeting Akali followed by Flash starts here; answer continues page11.
Continues Akali untargetable while out of combat: target invalidation causes the instructed effect to be ignored rather than performing it on an illegal target.
Ravenbloom student plus taking control of an opponent spell: resolve observers can trigger for the new controller, but play-confirmation history remains with the player who confirmed the spell.
Student triggers twice, Siege Engine gets one spell-play discount and opposing empowered effect remains applicable according to FAQ; current source/runtime reconciliation remains open.
Continues Gangplank swap: swap computes an already fixed difference; replacing his Might loss with +3 makes the illustrated pair 2 to6 and6 to9, without recalculating the other unit.
Spray Fruit stun is not targeted, so empowered Gangplank replacement does not apply; trying to stun an already stunned unit makes no new stun event and yields no replacement +3.
Knock on an empowered Gangplank at1 Might gives zero reduction due to minimum1, so there is no loss event to replace and no+3.
Akali movement-trigger battlefield reference remains captured from the original move even if Akali leaves before resolution; source departure does not erase the captured battlefield.
Empowered Heimer can acquire an exhaust-cost activated ability from unempowered Jayce; dependency text is part of the copied ability, and its empowered condition checks the new source.
Unempowered Heimer cannot use the empowered-granted ability.
Exact printed source identities/current core dependency and copy interactions remain to reconcile.
Hwei discarding a real unit/gear creates two independent inline triggers, order chosen by controller; every satisfied type creates its own effect, unlike choose-one templates.
FAQ cites historical387.1.b; actual current core page67 instead uses388.1.b.
Countering the first opponent spell after another was confirmed starts here, continued page9.
Top419.4 citations continue prior page11 and are not automatically the Swain question reference.
One real unit/gear plus one spell satisfies Swain non-token unit/gear/spell played history; separate unit/gear cards are unnecessary.
Swap with empowered Gangplank computes independent increase/decrease effects; continues page13.
Astral drake errata: after first-card trigger resolves, reduction applies to the next card put on the stack pending confirmation that turn.
Time warp plus ancient dragon and paid roost cost: choose either positively required play destination, continued page17.
Conflicting positive destination instructions can choose one when neither prohibits the other; permissions cannot override a prohibition.
Undead dragon cannot enter un-conquered roost by paying the optional destination cost; an unconfirmable play rolls back and card returns to its original zone.
A conquered other battlefield permits that dragon only there, not at an un-conquered roost.
Continues prohibition versus entry replacement: Baron enters the nest via replacement even when normal placement is restricted; roost wording is permission, not an entry replacement.
Unempowered Yi plus boon in combat triggers exactly one empower, because trigger condition must remain satisfied and empower is binary.
Dragon form on a previously knocked4 Might unit gives base5 under layers but final4 with arithmetic reduction; whether Fiora triggers continues page19.

Renekton at11 Might after disempower does not become10-or-more again through Knock or activating his ability unless the threshold is actually crossed from below10.
A spell/ability targeting at least one unit at World Shell ignores all SpellShield costs during that spell/ability's payment; this exemption does not extend to separate spells.
Top766/767 rule references continue the preceding SpellShield answer.
Emperor delayed ability retains its creating spell as a destruction source, so controller/owner/source conditions can trigger Phoenix from graveyard.
Ride the Wind cannot move a unit out of the nest but still readies it; linked-instruction explanation continues page22.
